findings.cause: smoothCoincidentNormals first computes normalized per-index normals, then averages duplicate-position seam normals. A mirrored seam can land on a non-seam vertex, so exact triangle mirroring does not imply exact averaged shader normals.

acceptance.shaderNormals: Maximum <=0.2 degrees, maximum <50% baseline, mean <5% baseline, plus unchanged finite/unit/outward checks.
acceptance.creaseBounds: Every present scoped crease boundingBox exactly equals Box3 computed from positions before normalized scene comparison.
